document.abstract: Over the past 12 months, exciting changes have occurred in our industry and the Digital Partnership Production (DPP) itself. In October 2022, the DPP became fully independent. This change has enabled the DPP to continue its growth as an international community and as an organization committed to delivering the most value to companies across the media and entertainment industry worldwide.

authors.bio: David Thompson is a technology strategist at the DPP. He is responsible for contributing to the DPP’s technical insight reports, and leading technological collaboration between DPP members. He is a senior broadcast specialist with more than 20 years of experience working in playout, media management, and in streaming distribution and monetization.
